tasks.title: Packet period
tasks.statement: ELRS is running at **{r} Hz**. What is the interval between packets (ms)?
tasks.solution: T = 1/f. For 250 Hz it's 4 ms; that's the lower bound of the radio link latency.

tasks.title: Telemetry rate
tasks.statement: Packet rate **{r} Hz**, telemetry ratio 1:**{n}**. How many telemetry packets per second go down?
tasks.solution: f_telem = rate / N. One out of N slots is given to the reply — that's why telemetry is always slower than control.
